hook.line: Someone interrupts, the talk wanders off, and you want your point back without sounding annoyed. Spanish has a polite handle for that.
hook.es: Como decía, me gustaría empezar por la historia del café.
hook.en: As I was saying, I'd like to start with the history of the café.

examples.es: Como decía, me gustaría empezar por la historia del café.
examples.en: As I was saying, I'd like to start with the history of the café.

examples.es: Como te estaba diciendo, el barrio ha cambiado mucho.
examples.en: As I was telling you (a friend), the neighbourhood has changed a lot.

examples.es: Volviendo a lo de antes, ¿vienes o no?
examples.en: Going back to what we were saying, are you coming or not? (to a friend)

examples.es: Como les decía, la reunión es a las tres.
examples.en: As I was telling you all, the meeting is at three.

examples.es: Como le decía, no vamos a vender.
examples.en: As I was telling you (formal), we are not going to sell.

examples.es: Como me decía Vale, el horno no funciona.
examples.en: As Vale was telling me, the oven isn't working.

rule:
To pick up a thought after an interruption, start with *como* plus a past "was saying": *como decía* (as I was saying) or *como te estaba diciendo* (as I was telling you).

The little word shows who you were talking to: *te* (a friend), *le* (one person, formal), *les* (you all), *me* (they were telling you). *Decía*, *estaba diciendo* and *iba diciendo* all work.

To go back to a topic, use *volviendo a* plus the topic: *volviendo a lo de antes* (going back to what we were saying).

Then simply carry on with your sentence.
smallPrint: Teachers call this a discourse marker that resumes a topic. The imperfect says the talking was already under way.

readAndPick.es: Como te estaba diciendo, no voy a vender.
options: As I was telling you (a friend), I'm not going to sell.
As I was telling you (formal), I'm not going to sell.
As I was telling you all, I'm not going to sell.

readAndPick.es: Como le decía, la reunión es mañana.
options: As I was telling you all, the meeting is tomorrow.
As I was telling you (a friend), the meeting is tomorrow.
As I was telling you (formal), the meeting is tomorrow.

readAndPick.es: Como les decía, el café cierra a las seis.
options: As I was telling you all, the café closes at six.
As I was telling you (formal), the café closes at six.
As I was telling you (a friend), the café closes at six.

readAndPick.es: Volviendo a lo de antes, ¿vienes o no?
options: Going back to what we were saying, are you coming or not?
Let's change the subject, are you coming or not?
As you were saying, are you coming or not?

readAndPick.es: Como decía, me gustaría empezar por el principio.
options: As you said, I'd like to start at the beginning.
As I was saying, I'd like to start at the beginning.
As they say, I'd like to start at the beginning.

readAndPick.es: Como me decía Vale, el horno no funciona.
options: As I was telling Vale, the oven isn't working.
As Vale was telling you, the oven isn't working.
As Vale was telling me, the oven isn't working.

readAndPick.es: Como te decía, ya hablé con el dueño.
options: As I was telling you (a friend), I already spoke with the owner.
As I was telling you (a friend), I'm going to speak with the owner.
As you were telling me, I already spoke with the owner.

readAndPick.es: Como decía mi abuela, hay que ser amable.
options: As my grandmother says, you have to be kind.
As my grandmother used to say, you have to be kind.
As I told my grandmother, you have to be kind.

yourTurn.prompt: Say "As I was saying, I'd like to start." Pick *decía* or *dije* and type the sentence: *Como ___, me gustaría empezar.*
yourTurn.why: *Decía* says you were already in the middle of talking.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: As I was saying, the café opens at eight.
yourTurn.answer: Como decía, el café abre a las ocho.
accept: Como estaba diciendo, el café abre a las ocho.
Como iba diciendo, el café abre a las ocho.
yourTurn.why: *Como decía* picks the thought back up, then the sentence carries on.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish (to a friend): As I was telling you, I'm not going to sell.
yourTurn.answer: Como te estaba diciendo, no voy a vender.
accept: Como te decía, no voy a vender.
yourTurn.why: *Te* shows you are talking to a friend.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish (to a group): As I was telling you all, the meeting is at three.
yourTurn.answer: Como les decía, la reunión es a las tres.
accept: Como les estaba diciendo, la reunión es a las tres.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish (to a friend): Going back to what we were saying, are you coming?
accept: Volviendo a lo de antes, ¿vienes o no?
yourTurn.why: *Volviendo a lo de antes* takes you back to the old topic.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it formal (to one person): *Como te decía, ya hablé con el dueño.* Say: As I was telling you (formal), I already spoke with the owner.
yourTurn.answer: Como le decía, ya hablé con el dueño.
accept: Como le estaba diciendo, ya hablé con el dueño.
yourTurn.why: Only *te* changes to *le* for a formal *usted*.

yourTurn.prompt: Type in Spanish: As Vale was telling me, the oven isn't working.
yourTurn.answer: Como me decía Vale, el horno no funciona.
accept: Como me estaba diciendo Vale, el horno no funciona.
yourTurn.why: *Me* shows that Vale was telling you.

pitfalls.wrong: Como estuve diciendo, me gustaría empezar.
pitfalls.right: Como estaba diciendo, me gustaría empezar.
pitfalls.why: Almost. You were in the middle of saying it, so it takes *estaba*, not *estuve*.

pitfalls.wrong: Como te decía a ustedes, la reunión es a las tres.
pitfalls.right: Como les decía, la reunión es a las tres.
pitfalls.why: Almost. The little word already names the people: *les* for you all.

pitfalls.wrong: Volver a lo de antes, ¿vienes o no?
pitfalls.right: Volviendo a lo de antes, ¿vienes o no?
pitfalls.why: Almost. To say "going back to" you need *volviendo*, not the plain verb.

personal: Think of the last time someone cut you off. How would you have taken your thought back? Start with *Como decía, …*.
